name: @brainstrike/agent
//@ai-sdk/anthropic: PINNED EXACTLY on purpose. ai-sdk-anthropic-mirror-contract.test.mjs asserts the three mirrors annotate the INSTALLED version, so a caret range lets a routine lockfile refresh float to 4.0.50 and redden the Unit lane on a doc comment rather than on real drift. An exact pin confines that to bump PRs where someone is already re-deriving the mirrors. REVIEW TRIGGER: raise it in a deliberate bump, re-run the contract, and correct the three annotations in the same change. Cost, stated: this forfeits automatic patch and security uptake for this package.
//@ai-sdk/openai: PINNED EXACTLY, and deliberately behind latest. 4.0.50 stopped preserving a tool-result own providerMetadata.openai.itemId and emits the CALL id for both item_reference entries, re-regressing the fix from 4.0.18 (changeset bc43dc2). That defeats OpenAIToolSearchHistoryCompat: duplicate item_references reach OpenAI, which rejects them. Bisected against the real SDK by src/__tests__/openai-tool-search-history-compat.spec.ts — 4.0.43/4.0.46/4.0.47/4.0.49 pass, 4.0.50/4.0.55/4.0.59/4.0.60 fail. Re-verified live on 2026-09-07 (BST-1671): 4.0.60 is still latest and still fails this spec with 4 red cases, so the hold stands and is not stale. REVIEW TRIGGER: re-run that spec whenever a dependency-bump PR proposes raising this, and raise it the moment the spec goes green on a newer version. It IS a CI gate, not a manual step — packages/agent/vitest.config includes src/**/__tests__/*.spec.ts, so a bump to a regressed version fails the Unit lane rather than merging green. Cost, stated, and it is wider than one duplicate package: @ai-sdk/amazon-bedrock depends on a newer openai directly, so the tree carries a second copy — packages/agent resolves 4.0.49 (asserted against the installed manifest), and Bedrock OpenAI-compatible models do not use the Responses-API item_reference path this compensates for. The pin still freezes this subtree transitives: openai 4.0.49 pulls @ai-sdk/provider 4.0.8 and provider-utils 5.0.32 while every other provider here is on 4.0.10 / 5.0.36, and packages/agent declares @ai-sdk/provider 4.0.10 directly. The undici half of that cost is RESOLVED as of BST-1671 and must stay resolved: provider-utils 5.0.32 declares undici ^7.28.0, which 7.29.1 satisfies, so `pnpm update undici -r` lifted this subtree off 7.28.0 WITHOUT touching the pin. That mattered because it was a shipped path: packages__agent>@ai-sdk/openai>@ai-sdk/provider-utils>undici carried one high and one moderate advisory (both patched >=7.29.0), and both cleared. 7.28.0 is now absent from the tree entirely. Re-check it after any lockfile refresh; the caret range means a fresh resolve picks >=7.29.1, so this should hold on its own. The provider skew is structurally compatible today and CI type-checks it; the day 4.0.x adds a required member to a LanguageModel interface, this pin is what will make the resulting error read as unrelated to either package. The openai mirror contract resolves the SAME copy on purpose — createRequire from packages/agent/package.json — so the nested Bedrock copy cannot become the version it reads.
